_comment: Departments that are NOT reachable by role alone. A team listed under
`restricted_teams` is hidden from every account except the people listed
in `allowed`, whatever their role is. A Super Admin who is not on this
list reaches every other department and not these.
Matching is by EMAIL, case-insensitively. `employee_id` is recorded for
reference only and is not what grants access, so it can be filled in
later without changing behaviour. Nothing here creates an account: an
entry for somebody who has no account simply never matches.
To grant somebody access, add an object to `allowed`. To restrict another
department, add its team slug to `restricted_teams`.
